Definition
[Differentiability at a point] 1. ch5:5.8-def-2\group Differentiability of Sobolev Functions A function $u: U \to \R $ is differentiable at $x \in U$ if there exists $a \in \R ^n$ such that \[ (13) \quad u(y) = u(x) + a \cdot (y - x) + o(|y - x|) \quad \text{as } y \to x. \] In other words, \[ \lim _{y \to x} \frac{|u(y) - u(x) - a \cdot (y - x)|}{|y - x|} = 0. \]
